title: ServingPreset
description: A curated recipe for serving one model on the platform's KServe/vLLM runtime. The chart ships a reviewed set (files/model-serving/presets/) and publishes each preset in effect as a ConfigMap in the release namespace (label agent-platform.giantswarm.io/serving-preset=true, key preset.yaml); modelServing.presets adds or replaces presets. The portal's serve flow and model-manager turn a published preset into an InferenceService; they never invent vLLM flags. Authoring form and published form share this schema: publishing fills the defaults noted below and resolves chatTemplate to the ConfigMap that holds it.

name.description: Lowercase DNS-1123 label, at most 30 characters. Names the preset ConfigMap (agent-platform-serving-preset-<name>), its chat-template ConfigMap (agent-platform-chat-template-<name>) and, by default, the InferenceService created from it.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the portal.

description.description: Notes for the operator: what the model is good at, the hardware the recipe was tuned on, known limits. Markdown.

id.description: Hugging Face repository (owner/name); the cache inventory and the import flow key on it.

storageUri.description: InferenceService predictor.model.storageUri. hf://<id> downloads through the KServe storage-initializer (into the cache when the Kyverno policies are on); pvc://<claim>/<dir> serves pre-warmed weights without a download.

format.description: predictor.model.modelFormat.name; must be a format the runtime lists in supportedModelFormats. Published presets always carry it.

contextLength.description: Context window in tokens the recipe serves (informational; --max-model-len in args is authoritative).

capabilities.description: Informational tags, e.g. chat, tools, reasoning, vision, coding, embeddings.

license.description: SPDX identifier or the model card's license name.

runtime.description: ClusterServingRuntime to run on. Empty or absent: modelServing.runtime.name; published presets always carry it.

args.description: vLLM server arguments appended to the runtime's, complete and literal. Do not pass --chat-template: publishing appends it from chatTemplate.

env.description: Extra environment of the runtime container (Kubernetes EnvVar).

chatTemplate.description: A chat template that replaces the model's own. Authoring: exactly one of file (shipped under files/model-serving/chat-templates/), content (inline) or existingConfigMap (pre-created in the serving namespace). Published: configMap names the ConfigMap in the serving namespace to mount at mountPath, and args ends with --chat-template=<mountPath>/<key>.

resources.description: Predictor resources. gpus is requested and limited as modelServing.serving.gpuResourceName; requests/limits are merged over the runtime's envelope by KServe.

requirements.description: Memory the recipe needs on the serving node: weights plus the KV cache, activations and runtime overhead. The portal's fit check compares weightsGiB + overheadGiB with the node's GPU (or unified) memory.

weightsGiB.description: Size of the weights as served (after quantization).

overheadGiB.description: Headroom for KV cache, activations, CUDA graphs and the runtime.

scheduling.description: Placement of the predictor on top of modelServing.serving: nodeSelector is merged over the component default.

predictor.description: Extra InferenceService predictor fields copied verbatim (e.g. minReplicas, timeout, deploymentStrategy); they win over the component defaults.
